notes: Buyer Splits: new 'Add Sus.A/C' button. When the buyers total fewer kattu than the seller was paid for, it adds a row that absorbs the leftover as a Suspense DEBIT against the seller (valued at his paid price), with an auto (editable) note like 'BD dd/mm/yyyy G-bill N kattu extra paid'. The balance tallies to zero and Save is enabled; the debit reverses if the invoice is cancelled.
